name: North County Fair
description: North County Fair is a premier Westfield shopping destination in Escondido, California, featuring over 160 stores including major department store anchors and popular brands like H&M, Sephora, Zara, and Adidas. This enclosed regional mall offers a comprehensive shopping experience with diverse retail, dining, and entertainment options serving North San Diego County.
demographics: Serves North San Diego County including Escondido, San Marcos, and surrounding communities with diverse demographics
summary: A major enclosed regional mall in North San Diego County offering 160+ stores with department store anchors and world-class brands.
